slides.title: North: health system at risk
slides.body: WHO chief Tedros warned on Nov. 2 that violence in Amhara and Tigray is pushing health care toward collapse (UN News).

slides.title: killed in Shirka, Arsi (Oromia)
slides.body: Ethiopia's rights commission (EHRC) confirmed the toll from the Oct. 24 attack, Addis Standard reported Nov. 4.

slides.title: Addis Ababa: The Reporter suspended
slides.body: The Ethiopian Media Authority suspended the newspaper indefinitely from Nov. 2, citing 'national interests' (AFP).

slides.title: fled southern Ethiopia into Kenya
slides.body: After clashes around Moyale. The UN allocated $3 million on Nov. 6 for aid in northern Kenya.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
